title: VAT-ID Attestation SD-JWT VC Schema
description: SD-JWT VC schema for the WE BUILD VAT-ID attestation, as specified in the VAT-ID Attestation Rulebook v0.7 (Belastingdienst Netherlands).

vct.description: Verifiable Credential Type identifier (SD-JWT VC). MUST NOT be selectively disclosable.

iat.description: Issuance date as Unix timestamp (RFC 7519). MUST NOT be selectively disclosable.

exp.description: Expiry date as Unix timestamp (RFC 7519). MUST NOT be selectively disclosable.

status.description: Status list claim for revocation checking. REQUIRED when technical validity period exceeds 24 hours. MUST NOT be selectively disclosable.

status_list_credential.description: URI of the Status List Credential document.

status_list_index.description: Zero-based index into the status list bitstring.

trust_anchor.description: URL of the machine-readable trust anchor for attestation verification (Annex V/VII point h). MUST NOT be selectively disclosable.

vat_id.description: VAT Identification Number. MUST NOT be selectively disclosable.

administrative_unit_name.description: Name of the administrative unit responsible for the VAT-ID. MUST NOT be selectively disclosable.

administrative_unit_type.description: Type of the administrative unit (e.g. GmbH, B.V., Government). Selectively disclosable (MUST).

registered_EU_cross_border_transactions.description: Boolean to indicate that the VAT-identification number of the economic operator registered in the European Union for cross border transactions on goods or services

validity_period.description: One or more validity periods for the VAT-ID. Selectively disclosable (MUST).

administrative_unit_address.description: Postal address of the administrative unit. Selectively disclosable (MUST).

economic_operator.description: Reference to the economic operator (legal or natural person). MUST NOT be selectively disclosable at object level. Exactly one of legal_identifier or personal_administrative_number/tin MUST be filled (rule EO1).

legal_identifier.description: Unique legal identifier (EUID or equivalent). Selectively disclosable (MUST).

legal_name.description: Legally registered name of the legal entity. Selectively disclosable (MUST).

family_name.description: Last name(s) of the natural person. Selectively disclosable (MUST).

given_name.description: First name(s) of the natural person. Selectively disclosable (MUST).

birth_date.description: Date of birth (ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD). Selectively disclosable (MUST).

birth_place.description: Place of birth (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, or city/region). Selectively disclosable (MUST).

personal_administrative_number.description: Unique personal administrative number assigned by the PID provider. Only if permitted by local law. Selectively disclosable (MUST).

economic_activity_type.description: Economic activity types (NACE or equivalent). Selectively disclosable (MUST).

issuer.description: Metadata about the issuing authority. MUST NOT be selectively disclosable.

authentic_source_country.description: ISO 3166-2 alpha-2 country code of the authentic source of the VAT-ID.

vat_id_authenticsource.description: Name of the administrative authority that issued the VAT-ID (authentic source).

country.description: ISO 3166-2 alpha-2 country code of the attestation issuer.

issuing_authority.description: Name of the authority or QTSP that issued the VAT-ID attestation.

attestation_legal_category.description: Legal category of the attestation per EU Digital Identity Regulation Annex V/VII point a).

location_status.description: URI for validity/revocation status information of the VAT-ID. Optional.

validity_period.description: A single validity period for the VAT-ID.

start_date.description: Start date of the VAT-ID validity period (ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD).

end_date.description: End date of the VAT-ID validity period (ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD). Optional; omit if open-ended.

address.description: Postal address object. All fields are optional.

economic_activity_type.description: A single economic activity type entry.

nomenclature.description: Nomenclature used. NACE is the default. MUST NOT be selectively disclosable.

id.description: Activity code within the nomenclature. Selectively disclosable (MUST).

description.description: Human-readable description per language (key = ISO 639-1 language code). Selectively disclosable (MUST).
